title: LLA to Flat Earth
text: Estimate flat Earth position from geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude, 5 inputs, 1 output; {Units}, {Planet model}, {Flattening}, {Equatorial radius of planet} sets the radius of planet at equator, {Input reference position and orientation}, {Reference geodetic latitude and longitude (deg)} sets the initial geodetic latitude and longitude and {Direction of local tangent plane x-axis (degrees clockwise from north)} sets the angle. Values come from the instance.
